hero.title: Your product is <accent>found</accent>, understood and recommended where decisions happen
hero.lead: Signal audits how discovery systems — AI assistants, search and marketplaces — answer about your category. You get scores with an explicit formula and a traceable chain of observation, evidence, hypothesis and action.

marquee.label: Discovery systems covered by the methodology
marquee.title: Segmentation by system

provenance.v: Formula, version and confidence on every score

problem.title: The decision starts with a question — not a search
problem.desc: Before the click, a chain of systems decides who gets into the answer, how it is characterized and who gets recommended. If your product doesn't pass through each link, it disappears from the conversation without you seeing it. Signal measures exactly these five links.

found.name: Found
found.desc: The product enters the set of candidates considered by the discovery system.

understood.name: Understood
understood.desc: Category, audience and problem are correctly associated with the product.

evidenced.name: Evidenced
evidenced.desc: Claims about the product are backed by verifiable external sources.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.desc: The product is cited in the relevant observed answers.

converted.name: Converted
converted.desc: The mention takes the decision-maker to the next step: visit, try or buy.

how.title: From setup to prioritized action
how.desc: Six traceable steps: you configure once, the run collects the answers and the report delivers what to do — with evidence for every conclusion.

profile.title: Product profile
profile.desc: URL, platform, market, language and reference competitors.

intents.title: Intents
intents.desc: The real problems people describe when looking for a solution.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.desc: The questions executed on the discovery systems, versioned.

execution.title: Execution
execution.desc: Collection of answers, recommendations and mentions.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.desc: External sources that support — or not — each claim.

report.title: Report
report.desc: Scores, gaps, opportunities and prioritized actions with traceability.

results.title: Scores with provenance and traceable evidence
results.desc: Every number in the report carries a formula, a version and a confidence. Every recommendation points back to the observation that originated it.

figures.recommendationShare: How much the product is recommended within the relevant answers.
figures.intentCoverage: Relevant intents in which the product appears at least once.
figures.evidenceCoverage: Intents with enough external evidence associated with the product.

traceable.title: Every recommendation is traceable back to the evidence
traceable.desc: The report visually separates what was observed, what is verifiable evidence, what is a hypothesis and what is a recommended action. No step skips the previous one: without observation there is no evidence; without evidence there is no action.

steps.observed: The product did not appear in any of the observed answers for “track cash flow”.
steps.evidence: CaixaFácil and ContaSimples appear in 68% of the intent's answers, backed by an article, a dedicated page and a community thread.
steps.hypothesis: The lack of an explicit association between the product and the term “cash flow” in the observed sources may be reducing presence.
steps.action: Create a dedicated cash flow page for small businesses and reinforce the association in the store listing — validate with a new audit in 2–4 weeks.

finalCta.title: Run an end-to-end audit in seconds
finalCta.desc: Configure the product, review intents and prompts, follow the run and explore the report with evidence, gaps and opportunities.
